description:
You're now in a kitchen. You can barely contain your excitement.

You make out a fridge. You idly wonder how they came up with the name TextWorld for this place. It's pretty fitting. You can see a closed oven here. Look out! It's a- oh, never mind, it's just a table. Wow, isn't TextWorld just the best? The table is massive. But the thing hasn't got anything on it. Were you looking for a counter? You lean against the wall, inadvertently pressing a secret button. The wall opens up to reveal a stove. But oh no! there's nothing on this piece of garbage.
